exposure: foetal myocardial deformation (LV ejection fraction, RV MyoGLS, RV EndoGLS)
baseline foetal heart rate at acquisition
outcome: operative delivery (caesarean or assisted vaginal birth) due to suspected intrapartum foetal compromise (IFC)
cohort: The study included uncomplicated singleton term pregnancies in early labour.
finding: Increased right ventricular myocardial deformation is associated with operative delivery due to suspected intrapartum foetal compromise, suggesting an early cardiac response to labour-related hypoxia.
mod_finding: Increased right ventricular myocardial deformation was associated with an increased likelihood of operative delivery (caesarean or assisted vaginal birth) due to suspected intrapartum foetal compromise.
